verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only narrow, form-scoped event→action behavior: new subscribers can be tagged on sign-up, and users control what happens after someone signs up. That is the product's own trigger-action capability, but there is no evidence of a general rule or automation builder. Zapier and API-driven list syncing are third-party or developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation/workflow builder, multiple event types (opens, clicks, dates, purchases), configurable conditions and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Tag new subscribers on sign-up so they're segmented and ready to receive the right emails from day one.
You control how often it shows and what happens after someone signs up.
